status.settings_blocked: Settings can't be opened while the sequence is running
drop.body:
Drop image, video or audio files here (or on the launcher) to add them as sources to "{scene}" in OBS.

Image png / jpg / gif / webp …
Video mp4 / mkv / mov / webm …
Audio mp3 / wav / ogg / flac …
flyout.swap_tip: Swap the apps in this row
head.admin_warn_tip: The launcher is running as administrator, so it can't receive drag & drop
status.obs_guard: OBS is running, so {name} wasn't opened. Right-click to open it anyway.
menu.dnd_attach: Put back next to the launcher
release.system: System processes and the launcher itself can't be closed
release.denied: Not enough rights (the launcher can't close processes running as administrator)
release.timeout: Timed out waiting for the process to close
set.title: DDLauncher Settings
col.name: Name
col.name.tip: Name shown at the bottom of the tile
col.group.tip: Apps in the same category share one slot and slide out sideways on mouse-over. Leave empty to keep the app separate
col.path.tip: The exe, shortcut or batch file to launch, or a web page URL
col.icon.tip: Image for the tile (png / jpg / ico, etc.), or a web address: a site's address uses that site's icon, an image's address uses that image. Empty = the exe's icon (for a URL, the site's icon)
col.args.tip:
Optional. Extra instructions given to the app when it starts. Leave empty if you don't need any.
Examples for OBS:
  --startstreaming   start streaming right away
  --minimize-to-tray   start hidden in the tray
  --scene "Scene name"   open with this scene
Separate several options with spaces.
col.delay_sec.tip: In the launch sequence, how many seconds after the previous app this one starts
col.minimized.tip: Start the app with its window minimized
col.admin.tip: Start the app with administrator rights (UAC prompt)
col.autostart.tip: Only checked apps are started, in order, by the ▶ launch sequence
col.obs_guard.tip: While OBS is running, clicking this icon does nothing, so a stray click can't open an app or page on stream. You can still open it from the right-click menu.
col.monitor.tip: Move the app's window to this monitor after it starts
col.browser.tip: Which browser opens the web address. Only used when the path is a web address (http / https)
col.process_name.tip: Exe name used to check whether the app is running. Empty = taken from the path
apps.hint: Drag rows to reorder / drag a heading to move the column / drag column edges to resize / hover a heading for help / Ctrl+Z brings back a removed row
ip.label: IP address type:
ip.tip: A note for yourself. "Detect" only checks whether this PC gets its IP address automatically (DHCP). It never reads the IP address itself.
ip.detect_none: No wired / Wi-Fi network connected to the internet was found.
ip.result.static: This PC uses a manually set IP address (static).
ip.result.dynamic:
This PC gets its IP address automatically (DHCP).

If your router always hands this PC the same address (a DHCP reservation), it is effectively static; change it to "Static" in that case.
ip.result.mixed: Static and automatic are mixed, depending on the connected network.
upnp.title: Router port forwarding (UPnP)
upnp.warning: ⚠ Opening a port lets anyone on the internet connect to that port on this PC. If the program receiving it has a weakness, someone could get in through it. Don't use this until you understand how it works, and always close ports when you are done.
upnp.none_found: No UPnP router was found. UPnP may be turned off in your router's settings.
upnp.open.tip: Opens the port in the selected row of the table above to this PC. It closes automatically after 24 hours.
upnp.select_port: Select the row of the port you want to open in the table above.
upnp.select_mapping: Select the row you want to close in this list.
upnp.not_self: Ports forwarded to other devices cannot be closed here. Close them from your router's settings page.
upnp.dangerous: Port {port} ({name}) cannot be opened: exposing it to the internet can lead to your PC being taken over or spied on.
upnp.open_confirm:
Open port {port} ({proto}) to this PC?

Anyone on the internet will be able to connect to this port.
It closes automatically after 24 hours.

Open it?
upnp.permanent_warn: This router does not support time-limited forwarding, so the port was opened with no time limit and will not close on its own. Always close it with "Close selected" when you are done.
upnp.failed: Could not talk to the router: {e}
ports.show_all: Also show unregistered ports in use
ports.detect_none: No new ports were found. OBS, OneComme and BouyomiChan are read from their settings; other apps can only be found while they are running.
ports.pick: Check the ports to add. They are read from each app's settings, so most can be found even when the app isn't running.
ports.note.bouyomi_mismatch: OneComme sends to BouyomiChan on port {onecomme}, but BouyomiChan's HTTP server is set to {bouyomi}. Speech won't reach it until they match.
ports.note.ync_dynamic: Yukarinette Connector NEO has “Choose available ports automatically” turned on, so its ports are decided when it starts. Start it, then press “{detect}” again.
ports.note.ync_stopped: Yukarinette Connector NEO isn't running. Start it and press “{detect}” again to read its ports.
ports.note.ync_auto_running: Yukarinette Connector NEO has “Choose available ports automatically” turned on, so the numbers may change the next time it starts. If they do, the Status column shows the current ones.
ports.not_in_use: The selected port isn't in use.
collapse.tip: In D&D mode and during the launch sequence, the launcher stays expanded either way
after.tip: Runs once every app is confirmed running. If anything failed or didn't start, the launcher stays visible
favicon.tip: Icons for web address tiles are downloaded once, saved on this PC and reused. If the site changes its icon, the saved one is not updated. With "Fetch again at every start", DDLauncher downloads them once more after it starts (the old icon stays if that fails).
gen.dnd_flush.check: In D&D mode, ignore the margin and snap to the screen edge (prevents dropping into the gap)
gen.group_rows.tip: How many apps go in one column. The rest start a new column further in
gen.group_cols.tip: How many columns at most. If more would be needed, the columns grow taller instead
gen.max_rows.tip: Apps that don't fit in the L shape go into a second L shape inside it
gen.keep_rot.check: Save the order rotated with the wheel / ▲▼ and show it next time
gen.wheel_rotate.check: Rotate the icons with the wheel / Shift+wheel (▲▼ and Ctrl+wheel still work when off)
gen.show_seq.check: Show the ▶ (launch sequence) button in the header
gen.name_upper.check: Show names on tiles in all capitals
color.reset_confirm: Put all colors back to the default?
color.template_confirm: Replace your current custom colors with this template?
gen.startup.check: Start the launcher with Windows and run the launch sequence
dbg.backup.hint: Only the checked items are exported / imported. The file can be read in Notepad, so you can fix things by hand if monitors etc. don't match on another PC.
dbg.import_empty: This file has no settings for the chosen items.
dbg.uninstall.body:
1. Turn off "Startup" under "General" and press OK (removes the Windows auto-start entry)
2. If you like, save your settings with "Export" above
3. Quit DDLauncher (right-click the tray icon → "Quit")
4. Delete these folders / files
   - Program: {app}
   - Settings & cache: {config}{legacy}

Note: the {parent} folder is also used by other CBApps software, so don't delete it as a whole.
un.title: Uninstall DDLauncher
un.step1.hint: Before removing anything, you can save your settings to a file. To move to another PC, copy that file there, then in DDLauncher open ⚙ → "Info", turn Debug Mode ON and use "Import".
un.step2.hint: Only checked items are moved to the Recycle Bin. Expand ▸ to see what's inside. Files unrelated to DDLauncher never appear here.
un.add_folder: Add a folder with an older exe…
un.none_found: No DDLauncher exe was found in this folder.
un.select_none: Check at least one item to remove.
un.running: DDLauncher is running. Right-click its tray icon → "Quit", then try again.
un.confirm:
These will be moved to the Recycle Bin. Continue?

{items}
un.done: Done. You can still restore them from the Recycle Bin.
un.self: Delete this uninstaller ({path}) yourself after closing it.
dbg.uninstall.tool: The included DDLauncher-Uninstall.exe moves what you choose to the Recycle Bin, older versions included.
nf.title: Move NexusFont to another PC
nf.group.hint: Packs NexusFont's sets and library, plus the font files, into one zip file that you can load on another PC.
nf.notice: This is for moving your own PC. Most commercial fonts may not be given to other people, so please don't share the file you export.
nf.pick_folder: Choose the NexusFont folder (where nexusfont.exe is)
nf.col.name: Name
nf.no_space: Not enough free space at the destination (needs {size}, free {free}).
nf.missing_list:
Skipped because they were not found ({n}):
{files}
nf.cancelled_export: Stopped. The unfinished file was deleted.
nf.cancelled_import: Stopped. Fonts copied so far are kept. NexusFont's sets and library were not changed.
nf.bad_zip: This is not a NexusFont file exported by DDLauncher.
nf.running: NexusFont is running. Close it and import again (if it's changed while running, NexusFont puts the old library back when it closes).
nf.not_found_import: NexusFont was not found. Install it first, or choose its folder with "Change…".
nf.pick_dest: Choose the folder to put the fonts in
nf.checking: Checking the files already in that folder…
nf.import_confirm:
Fonts go here:
{dest}

New: {new} files
Already there (skipped): {same} files

NexusFont's sets and library will be replaced with the ones in this zip. The current ones are backed up first. Continue?
nf.overwrite_confirm: {n} files have the same name but different contents. Overwrite them? (The old files go to the Recycle Bin. "No" keeps them.)
nf.imported:
Done. Start NexusFont to use them.
Backup: {backup}
nf.mode.move: Fit the new PC (choose where the fonts go when importing)
nf.mode.asis: As is (same folders and window layout as this PC)
nf.asis_dest: The same places as on the original PC (folders kept as they were):
nf.missing_drives: This PC has no {drives} drive, so the fonts can't go back to the same places. Import stopped.
nf.window_fix: Bring the window back on screen
nf.window_hint: If NexusFont opens off screen: select it on the taskbar, press Alt+Space, then M (Move), press an arrow key once and move the mouse to pull it back. You can also close NexusFont and press this button.
nf.window_ok: NexusFont's window is already on screen.
nf.window_fixed: Moved to the main screen. NexusFont will open there next time.
nf.window_offscreen_confirm: NexusFont's window would open off screen (this PC's monitors differ from the original PC). Move it to the main screen?
nf.running_window: NexusFont is running. Close it and press the button again.
color.live_hint: Colors and opacity show up on the launcher right away (OK saves them, Cancel puts them back). Hover a color button to make the parts using that color slowly shift through colors on the launcher.
snd.hint: Save which output / input devices are the default, plus their mute and volume, as a profile, and switch with one click (also from the tray icon menu).
snd.auto: If Windows switches the default device by itself (for example when you plug in a webcam or a game controller), switch it back to the applied profile
snd.with_levels: Also restore mute and volume when applying
snd.name: Name:
snd.overwrite_confirm: Replace "{name}" with the current device state?
snd.delete_confirm: Delete the profile "{name}"? (It stays in the settings until you press OK.)
snd.failed: Could not use the sound devices: {e}
snd.missing_list:
These devices are not on this PC, so they were skipped:
{names}
seq.timeline: Launch sequence timeline (checked apps only, seconds from the start)
seq.empty: No apps are in the launch sequence.
apps.select_row: Select a row in the table first (click the row).
ar.backup: Back up before you change anything
ar.backup.hint: Changes here affect what starts when you sign in to Windows. Before changing anything, take a screenshot of the list, or use "Copy list" and paste it into Notepad. To be able to roll back all of Windows, create a restore point.
ar.copied: The list is on the clipboard. Paste it into Notepad or similar and save it.
ar.regedit.hint: To save the whole registry, open Registry Editor, choose File → Export, and set the range to "All".
ar.auto_backup: When you press OK, the current entries are saved automatically before anything changes ({path}, last 5 times).
arcol.enabled.tip: Turn off to stop it starting at sign-in without deleting the entry (same as "Disable" in Task Manager)
arcol.name: Name
arcol.when.tip: Windows entries start at sign-in; sequence apps show the time from the start of the sequence
arcol.command.tip: The file to start and its arguments. Double-click to edit
ar.sec.seq: DDLauncher launch sequence (change it in the "{tab}" tab)
ar.tip.self: DDLauncher's own entry. Turn it on or off with "Startup" in the "General / OBS" tab.
ar.tip.admin: Shared by all users. Changing it needs administrator rights, so it's shown here for reference only.
ar.hint: Changes take effect when you press OK; until then, changed rows are tinted orange. Cancel leaves everything as it was. Gray rows can't be changed here. Right-click a row to open its location or properties.
ar.err.empty: "{name}": the name and command can't be empty.
ar.err.badname: "{name}": contains characters that can't be used in file names (\ / : * ? " < > |).
ar.backup_failed: Couldn't save the backup, so auto-start was left unchanged: {e}
ar.menu.not_found: The file to start wasn't found
addr.tip: When ON, shows file locations, web addresses and the OBS host. Keep it OFF while streaming so they can't show up by accident. It goes back to OFF each time you open Settings.
addr.label: Show addresses
addr.locked: Addresses are hidden. Turn "Show addresses" ON at the bottom left to see or edit them.
gen.dnd_on_launcher.check: In D&D mode, files dropped on the launcher are added too, same as the D&D space
gen.dnd_reset: If the D&&D space is lost
gen.dnd_reset.btn: Put the D&&D space back next to the launcher (default size)
gen.dnd_reset.done: The D&D space is back next to the launcher at its default size.
gen.dnd_warn.tip: Asks before adding when you drop this many files at once, so a stray drop can't fill OBS with sources
dnd.many.title: Add many files?
dnd.many.body: You're about to add {n} files to OBS as sources. Add them?
dnd.many.cancelled: Cancelled. Nothing was added to OBS.
gen.dnd_pick.check: When you drop a folder or several kinds of files, choose which kinds to add (also reads inside folders and uses the extensions below)
gen.dnd_ext.tip: Separate with spaces or commas (e.g. png jpg webp). Leave empty to skip that kind. Only used when the option above is on.
dnd.pick.title: Choose what to add
dnd.pick.body: Choose which kinds of files to add to OBS.
dnd.pick.truncated: There are a lot of files, so only the first {n} are included.
dnd.pick.none: No files that can be added were found.
gen.add_visible.check: Show the added source in the scene
add_start.first: Play only the first file, stop the rest
gen.add_volume.tip: Volume of video / audio sources, in dB like OBS's audio mixer (0 dB = unchanged)
gen.add_restart.check: Restart playback when the source becomes active (OBS default)
gen.add_fit.check: Fit images / videos to the canvas, keeping the aspect ratio
add_name.name: File name (with extension)
gen.add_loop_exts.placeholder: Empty = all video / audio (e.g. mp3 wav)
gen.add_fit.tip: If you use Image Resize Reader for OBS, leave this off and let it do the fitting: with both on, the source ends up shifted or cut off.
conflict.title: Names already in use
conflict.body: These files have the same name as a source, scene or group in OBS (or as another dropped file). Choose what to do with each.
conflict.col.name: Source name
hdr.fit_title: Fit this column to its heading
hdr.fit_content: Fit this column to its contents
hdr.fit_title_all: Fit all columns to their headings
hdr.fit_content_all: Fit all columns to their contents
